.claude/hooks/bifrost-detect.sh.name: Assistant setup check
.claude/hooks/bifrost-detect.sh.description: Runs when an AI coding assistant opens the project and reports whether it can reach the code, sign-in and services.

.claude/settings.json.name: Assistant hook settings
.claude/settings.json.description: Registers the startup check that runs whenever an AI coding assistant opens this project.

.claude/skills/bifrost-build/references/.name: Build skill sources
.claude/skills/bifrost-build/references/.description: Lists the code and documentation places the build assistant reads so its answers stay accurate.

.claude/skills/bifrost-copilot-cowork-pa.name: Copilot plugin packager
.claude/skills/bifrost-copilot-cowork-pa.description: Bundles an agent into a Microsoft 365 Copilot plugin zip with its manifest, skills and connection details.

.claude/workflows/solutions-qa-fanout.mj.name: Solutions QA sweep
.claude/workflows/solutions-qa-fanout.mj.description: Sets out a multi-agent quality pass that drives the real screens and command line, verifies findings and ranks them.

.claude/workflows/solutions-scope-shakeo.name: Solutions scope review
.claude/workflows/solutions-scope-shakeo.description: Sets out a multi-agent audit of who can see and change Solutions, plus a critic pass for untested cases.

api/scripts/__init__.py.name: Admin scripts package
api/scripts/__init__.py.description: Marks the folder of administrative scripts as one importable package.

api/scripts/agent_code_mode_spike.py.name: Agent tool-mode trial
api/scripts/agent_code_mode_spike.py.description: Runs a credential-free trial of an agent calling its tools directly, to prove that path works end to end.

api/scripts/api-allocator.sh.name: Shared memory tuning
api/scripts/api-allocator.sh.description: Applies the memory allocator settings the server needs, shared by both the normal and direct startup paths.

api/scripts/build_cli_artifact.py.name: Command-line bundle builder
api/scripts/build_cli_artifact.py.description: Packages the command-line tool into the archive the server hands out for download.

api/scripts/check_github_action_pins.py.name: Action pin check
api/scripts/check_github_action_pins.py.description: Fails when a GitHub automation step is not locked to an exact commit, or its version comment is wrong.

api/scripts/check_live_reasoning.py.name: Live reasoning check
api/scripts/check_live_reasoning.py.description: Asks real AI providers the configured reasoning questions to confirm the settings actually reach them.

api/scripts/elastic_runtime_memory.py.name: Memory footprint probe
api/scripts/elastic_runtime_memory.py.description: Measures how much memory the server uses while starting up and building its parts in fresh processes.

api/scripts/generate_access_list.py.name: Access list generator
api/scripts/generate_access_list.py.description: Turns the hand-maintained access list into the machine-readable file the app ships with.

api/scripts/init_container.py.name: Startup preparation task
api/scripts/init_container.py.description: Applies database changes and warms caches before the server starts, and refuses to run against a newer database.

api/scripts/inspect_agent_run_step_strea.name: Agent run stream inspector
api/scripts/inspect_agent_run_step_strea.description: Shows one bounded page of an agent run's live step records without changing anything.

api/scripts/install-npm.sh.name: Pinned package tool installer
api/scripts/install-npm.sh.description: Installs one specific, checksum-verified version of the JavaScript package tool inside the image.

api/scripts/kubernetes_build_spike.py.name: Cluster build trial
api/scripts/kubernetes_build_spike.py.description: Exercises app builds as short-lived cluster tasks in a local test cluster from start to finish.

api/scripts/lean_runner_spike.py.name: Lean job runner trial
api/scripts/lean_runner_spike.py.description: Probes how little memory a slim background-job parent and its helper processes can get by with.

api/scripts/migrate_app_files_to_s3.py.name: App file move
api/scripts/migrate_app_files_to_s3.py.description: Copies stored app files out of the database into cloud file storage and indexes them for search.

api/scripts/operation_catalog/generate.p.name: Operation catalog builder
api/scripts/operation_catalog/generate.p.description: Generates the list of operations and the compact reference the build assistant relies on.

api/scripts/quality_api.sh.name: Server code checks
api/scripts/quality_api.sh.description: Runs the type checker and linter over the server code inside its container.

api/scripts/report_test_costs.py.name: Slow test report
api/scripts/report_test_costs.py.description: Ranks automatic checks by how long each test file takes, using the recorded run results.

api/scripts/scheduler_fixture_server.py.name: Test service stand-in
api/scripts/scheduler_fixture_server.py.description: Stands in for outside services during tests, answering with fixed AI, tool and repository responses.

api/scripts/skill-truth/dump-app-sdk-sur.name: App building-block listing
api/scripts/skill-truth/dump-app-sdk-sur.description: Writes a sorted list of everything the in-app building blocks offer, so documentation stays accurate.

api/scripts/skill-truth/generate.py.name: Assistant reference generator
api/scripts/skill-truth/generate.py.description: Rebuilds the assistant's command, code and type references from the real source.

api/scripts/skill-truth/lint_claims.py.name: Command reference check
api/scripts/skill-truth/lint_claims.py.description: Checks every command example in the assistant's notes against the real command tree.

api/scripts/skill-truth/lint_examples.py.name: Code example check
api/scripts/skill-truth/lint_examples.py.description: Runs every code sample in the assistant's notes against the real building blocks to catch stale snippets.

api/scripts/thin_provider_fixture.py.name: Provider stand-in
api/scripts/thin_provider_fixture.py.description: Pretends to be an outside AI provider so background-job tests can run without real credentials.

api/scripts/update_model_catalog_snapsho.name: Model list refresh
api/scripts/update_model_catalog_snapsho.description: Refreshes the bundled list of available AI models that ships with the server.

api/scripts/uvicorn-shim.sh.name: Direct server launcher
api/scripts/uvicorn-shim.sh.description: Applies the memory settings even when the cluster starts the server directly and skips normal startup.

api/scripts/verify_merge_candidate.py.name: Merge safety check
api/scripts/verify_merge_candidate.py.description: Refuses to proceed unless that exact code revision passed the full pre-merge checks.

api/scripts/worker_memory_probe.py.name: Worker memory sampler
api/scripts/worker_memory_probe.py.description: Samples the memory each running background task container uses on the host machine.

plugins/bifrost/skills/bifrost-build/ref.name: Plugin build sources
plugins/bifrost/skills/bifrost-build/ref.description: Lists the same authoritative sources for the packaged plugin copy of the build assistant.

plugins/bifrost/skills/bifrost-copilot-c.name: Plugin packager copy
plugins/bifrost/skills/bifrost-copilot-c.description: Packages an agent as a Copilot plugin and is kept identical to the assistant-folder copy.

scripts/bench/cluster.py.name: Cluster access for benchmarks
scripts/bench/cluster.py.description: Reads pod memory, database counters and worker processes from the local cluster during benchmark runs.

scripts/bench/incluster/driver.py.name: In-cluster benchmark driver
scripts/bench/incluster/driver.py.description: Runs each timed workload class from inside the cluster against a live platform.

scripts/bench/incluster/fake_llm.py.name: Fake model for benchmarks
scripts/bench/incluster/fake_llm.py.description: Answers model requests with fixed replies so timing runs are repeatable and need no real provider.

scripts/bench/manifests/bench.yaml.name: Benchmark cluster setup
scripts/bench/manifests/bench.yaml.description: Describes the pods and settings used to run the benchmark harness in the local cluster.

scripts/bench/report.py.name: Benchmark report
scripts/bench/report.py.description: Turns a benchmark result file into a readable summary for comparison.
